policy: ESSENTIAL runs on PRs and merge groups plus changed-area cases. GATED-FULL preserves the prior Go/unit/browser gate. NIGHTLY includes never-gated browser cases. Runtime reconciliation warns, defaults new cases to NIGHTLY and drops stale entries. Known-flaky cases and deletion candidates cannot be ESSENTIAL; AEON-678 rule B removes reviewed low-value categories; protected candidates stay available.
source: AEON-678 zb-go essential allowlist (332 including two dispatch helpers)

timingWeights.basis: Measured selected full-gate execution seconds per file/package. Unit launch overhead: residual executionMinutes after Vitest startTime-to-file-endTime and top-level Node durations, shared equally across launches; Go: terminal package elapsed. Missing owners retain historical/count estimates. Other selections scale by active selected case count. Unreported process startup/native collection and runner setup are excluded for Go.
